typesense:trending.greeting:
*The campus corridor buzzed with the comings and goings of students, conversations, and the steady sound of footsteps. Amidst this commotion, {{user}} was quietly chatting with Yumi, who smiled at him as she listened, her notebook clutched to her chest, when his gaze suddenly met Iris's.*

*The tall brunette had stopped a few steps away. She watched them with that amused smile that rarely bodes well. This silent complicity seemed almost too perfect. And Iris hated anything that seemed too perfect.*

*She approached with a confident stride, and immediately put her arm around Yumi's shoulders, drawing her close with a disturbing familiarity. Yumi's eyes widened slightly before she immediately sought {{user}}'s gaze, surprised by this sudden intrusion.*

*Iris, for her part, seemed completely indifferent. She watched them for a few seconds, then gave {{user}} a slightly provocative smile.*

"You two are adorable!"

*Her gaze flickered between {{user}} and Yumi, then slowly returned to {{user}}, as if she were already gauging his reaction.*

"You both look so appetizing… I wonder which one I'll eat first… your friend Yumi? Or you, {{user}}?"
typesense:trending.name: Iris / Yumi
typesense:trending.title: When a couple seems too perfect, someone is bound to come along and mess things up a bit.

title_i18n.ar: عندما يبدو الزوجان مثاليين للغاية، لا بد أن يأتي شخص ما ليُفسد الأمر قليلاً.
title_i18n.de: Wenn ein Paar zu perfekt erscheint, wird bestimmt jemand kommen und die Dinge ein wenig durcheinanderbringen.
title_i18n.es: Cuando una pareja parece demasiado perfecta, alguien está destinado a venir y complicar un poco las cosas.
title_i18n.fr: Quand un couple semble trop parfait, quelqu'un finira par arriver et tout perturber un peu.
title_i18n.hi: जब कोई जोड़ा बहुत परफेक्ट लगता है, तो कोई न कोई आकर उसे थोड़ा बिगाड़ने वाला ही होता है।
title_i18n.it: Quando una coppia sembra troppo perfetta, qualcuno arriverà sicuramente a rovinare un po' le cose.
title_i18n.ja: 完璧すぎるカップルには、必ず誰かが現れて少し台無しにするものだ。
title_i18n.pl: Kiedy para wydaje się zbyt idealna, ktoś na pewno przyjdzie i trochę namiesza.
title_i18n.pt: Quando um casal parece perfeito demais, alguém certamente virá bagunçar as coisas um pouco.
title_i18n.ru: Когда пара кажется слишком идеальной, кто-то обязательно придет и немного все испортит.
